title: BackBufferCopy rect-mode doesn't work properly
body:
### Tested versions

Tested and Reproducible in: 4.3-stable, 4.4.1-stable, 4.5-beta3

### System information

Linux Mint 22.1 (Xia) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated Intel(R) Iris(R) Plus Graphics 655 (CFL GT3) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-8559U CPU @ 2.70GHz (8 threads)

### Issue description

The Gizmo of the BackBufferCopy-Node, seemingly intended to visualize and edit the Region that gets saved, doesn't succeed in this job.

Firstly interacting with the gizmo doesn't actually change the `rect`-property, instead affecting `position` and `scale`.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1823b6c8-34e6-4a40-9341-08e43427852a

this might be intended, at least if the transform of the node were to affect the Region of the BackBuffer. But that doesn't seem to be the case either. It actually ignores all transforms, only working in screen coordinates.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/90f0c113-d2a5-4a12-b39a-0d9625c9b140

### Steps to reproduce

Just open the project and move/zoom the camera or move the Nodes or Gizmo. The Backbuffer has a ColorRect of the same size displaying its content in front of it, showing that it doesn't match except for zoom 100% and the node being right in the upper left corner of the Viewport. The BackBufferCopy-Node has a tool script that can be enabled, showing what logic seems to be missing.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[backbuffercopy-bugs.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21368960/backbuffercopy-bugs.zip)
